title: HelperSSHTrustHostKeyResult
description: What the write produced: the fingerprint of the key now recorded for that host. It is the same value the coordinator's own accept path already returns (RealClient.TrustHostKey), so the evidence a person sees after accepting a host does not depend on which process did the writing.

fingerprint.description: The SHA256 fingerprint of the recorded key, in the `SHA256:base64` form ssh.FingerprintSHA256 produces.
